## UploadByteSource type

The bytes of one upload, in order.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type UploadByteSource = AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> | ReadableStream<Uint8Array>
```

## Remarks

Every chunk must be a `Uint8Array` (a `Buffer` is one). Ending the source completes the upload; a source that throws leaves it incomplete.
